description: Find events happening in a city: concerts, DJ and club nights, comedy and theater, pop-ups and supper clubs, night markets and flea markets, festivals and street fairs, parties, classes, exhibitions. Pass what the user asked for in plain words as `query` ("techno this weekend in Oakland", "spooky things to do friday", "farmers market sunday morning"); time and place in the words are understood. Say who it is for in the same words ("comedy this weekend for my parents, they hate crowds", "things to do with my kids saturday"): what suits them comes first. Use `from`/`to`, `place` or `near` when you already know them exactly. Returns events with start times in the local timezone, the venue, a summary, tags, ticket and source links, and why each matched. Covers the San Francisco Bay Area today; a place outside it comes back as not covered, with no events. For more, call again with the `offset` a search returns as next_offset.

from.description: ISO 8601 start of the window. Overrides any time in the query.

offset.description: Skip this many, for the next page: pass the next_offset a search returned.

place.description: A city or neighborhood by name, e.g. "Oakland", "the Mission".

query.description: What to find, in plain words. May include when, where, and who it is for.

name: search_events
title: Search local events
